sentences.en: The Choate Story Book (New York, 1903) contains a few of his addresses and after-dinner speeches, and is prefaced by a brief biographical sketch.
sentences.vi: Cuốn sách Câu chuyện Choate (New York, 1903) chứa một số địa chỉ và bài phát biểu sau bữa tối của ông, và được mở đầu bằng một bản phác thảo tiểu sử ngắn gọn.

sentences.en: The two scholars in course of time created a movement resembling that of the I To be distinguished from scolium (oKOXLov), an after-dinner song.

sentences.en: Needless to say, you'll also probably have treated yourself to a few fine wines and after-dinner cognacs!
sentences.vi: Không cần phải nói, bạn cũng có thể đã chiêu đãi bản thân một vài loại rượu vang hảo hạng và rượu cognac sau bữa tối!

sentences.en: These three light dishes, combine beautifully and leave you with just enough space for an after-dinner mint!

sentences.en: On our after-dinner walks through the grounds we had heard a nightjar churring in the wet scrub just to the east of the hotel.

sentences.en: Our after-dinner speaker was Trevor Kerry, Professor of Education, University of Lincoln.

sentences.en: Gary is available for live presenting and awards hosting, as well as conference and after-dinner speaking engagements.

sentences.en: The government of the world I live in was not framed, like that of Britain, in after-dinner conversations over the wine.

sentences.en: The count, holding his cards fanwise, kept himself with difficulty from dropping into his usual after-dinner nap, and laughed at everything.
sentences.vi: Vị đếm, cầm những lá bài của mình theo chiều hướng quạt, khiến bản thân khó chợp mắt vào giấc ngủ trưa sau bữa tối như thường lệ, và cười nhạo mọi thứ.

sentences.en: Pierre was in an agreeable after-dinner mood.
sentences.vi: Pierre có tâm trạng thoải mái sau bữa tối.
